bull_case: Satellite services, sovereign demand and AI-ready geospatial data compound revenue well above 20% for years while gross margin and capital efficiency improve. Owner FCF/share reaches roughly $3 by year 10, supporting value materially above today even under the locked 25x Bull terminal multiple.
bear_case: Recent growth is partly contract-timing and government concentration, capex remains heavy, dilution persists and competition compresses pricing. Owner FCF/share rises only slowly toward $0.45 by year 10, leaving value far below the current price.
thesis: At $16.99, Planet is near but modestly above the locked Base DCF of about $15.94, not an expectation-gap valuation. The price does not require the Bull case, but it requires sustained >20% growth, meaningful per-share FCF scaling and controlled dilution. Q2 growth, RPO/backlog and positive YTD FCF support that path, while ATM issuance, customer concentration and terminal-value dependence make valuation robustness only mixed.

evidence.claim: Frozen 2026-09-17 close is $16.99 and frozen market cap is about $6.18B, below the new $20B Moonshot cap.
evidence.source: StockAnalysis / Investing.com historical price; uploaded Q2 10-Q share count

evidence.claim: FY2027 Q2 revenue was $116.1M, up 58% YoY; H1 revenue was $210.2M. Full-year FY2027 revenue guidance is $430M-$441M.
RPO was $753.1M and backlog $814.9M at July 31, with approximately 46% of RPO expected within 12 months; recurring ACV was 98%.
H1 operating cash flow was $68.4M and reported free cash flow $21.3M, but FY2027 capex guidance remains $100M-$115M.
Planet raised approximately $120M through its ATM program in Q2 at an average net sale price of $31.95, showing that equity issuance remains part of capital funding.
Locked owner-FCF/share DCF produces Bear/Base/Bull values of about $5.22/$15.94/$39.36, with current price about 1.066x Base; Base terminal value is roughly 77% of operating value.
evidence.source: Deterministic harness valuation using frozen price/net cash and fixed 9%/15x-20x-25x policy

counterevidence: Three customers represented 17%, 11% and 10% of Q2 revenue, making reported growth sensitive to large contract timing and renewal decisions.
FY2027 Q3 guidance implies sequential revenue decline and adjusted EBITDA loss, so Q2's 58% growth and EBITDA margin should not be extrapolated mechanically.
The Base valuation depends heavily on terminal value and assumes FCF/share compounds far beyond the current early-positive level.
ATM issuance and stock-based compensation can dilute per-share economics even if enterprise revenue and cash flow grow.
unknowns: Full-cycle gross margin and FCF margin of sovereign satellite-services contracts versus data subscriptions.
Maintenance/replacement capex required for Pelican, SuperDove and hyperspectral fleets at scale.
Long-run dilution from SBC, ATM issuance and potential convertible-note settlement.
Five-year self-valuation percentile on a consistent EV/revenue or EV/FCF metric.

uncertainties.rationale: Current price can be justified without a Bull path, but only if strong growth converts into much larger per-share FCF.
Locked Base value is slightly below the current price, leaving limited margin of safety.
Terminal value is a large share of Base/Bull value and long-run FCF margin is not yet proven.

falsifiers: Revenue growth remains high but owner FCF/share fails to improve because capex and dilution scale with revenue.
RPO/backlog conversion weakens materially or sovereign contract economics prove structurally lower margin than assumed.
A realistic Bull FCF/share path falls below the current price under the locked DCF policy.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: The frozen $16.99 price is only modestly above the locked Base value (~$15.94) and materially below the Bull value (~$39.36). Valuation is demanding but does not require a Bull-plus outcome.

key_kpis.name: Owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Sustain positive FCF and compound materially faster than share count

key_kpis.name: RPO/backlog conversion
key_kpis.threshold: Contracted demand converts to revenue without a proportional deterioration in margin/capex

key_kpis.name: Diluted share count
key_kpis.threshold: Revenue/FCF per share improves despite SBC, ATM and convertible exposure

next_checks: FY2027 Q3 revenue, gross margin, adjusted EBITDA and capex versus guidance.
Satellite-services gross-margin/cash-conversion evidence as Swedish/German/NGA programs scale.
Share-count and ATM activity after Q2 issuance.

subscores.rationale: Current price requires strong execution and FCF scaling but remains below a plausible Bull case.
Price is close to but modestly above locked Base value, implying roughly fair-to-slightly-expensive valuation.
Long-duration value is highly sensitive to terminal FCF/share, capital intensity and dilution.
